ns0:g.ns0:text: Parallel and counterflow layouts create different temperature-difference profiles
Steady exchanger, constant properties, no heat leak or phase change. These profiles solve equal-capacity-rate balances: parallel outlets≈65.41/54.59°C,
counterflow outlets both 60°C at opposite ends. Cold-stream arrow reverses in counterflow.
